summary: Blueprint 03 (AI Project Planner & Guided Workspace) verified end-to-end and Blueprint 02 collision fix confirmed. Backend: 15/15 new B03 pytest cases pass, plus all 21/21 B01+B02 tests still green after the legacy POST /api/hi/rooms removal. Frontend: full happy-path drive on mobile viewport (390x844) using demo_home works — /home-intel dashboard 'Plan a Project' → Projects list → Start form (all chip/goal testIDs) → LLM plan generation (~10s) → Workspace (title, safety banner 'Verify first', meta Beginner/2-3h/$30-80/Low Risk, progress bar 0%·0/10, Preparation list) → Ask Homie modal returns a real answer → Complete Step advances progress → Shopping List (grouped, 7 have_it toggles work) → Complete flow (cmp-completed selected by default, cmp-save persists) → Success screen shows all 4 next-* actions. Emergency goal 'gas + sparks' correctly returns 409 on POST /plan and project row is marked escalated with safety_status='Stop and contact a professional'. B02 fix holds: POST /api/hi/rooms now returns rich room {room_type, persistent_room_id=id, status:'active'}, map/profile still work, and asset creation by room_name links room_id. No blockers found.
action_items: Nothing blocking. Minor cleanup carried over from iter_46 (still valid, non-blocking): (1) simplify `(req.notes or None)[:1000] if req.notes else None` in home_intelligence_engine.record_outcome; (2) avoid `list_collection_names()` call inside room_profile — use try/except or cache the list.

Optional: `project_planner_engine._context()` reads asset docs only when `processing_status=='done'` — if a fresh doc is still 'processing' the context is empty. Consider a short retry OR include 'processing' docs' partial text once vision completes.

Optional: LLM occasionally returns needs_clarification for very short goals; the frontend Start screen retries only via a manual re-tap. Consider auto-submitting with the user's selected category after clarify to smooth UX.
critical_code_review_comments: project_planner_engine.py: emergency detection uses regex list (`DANGER`). Consider centralising with home_intelligence_engine.EMERGENCY_PATTERNS to keep behaviour aligned across blueprints.
generate_plan deletes prior phases/steps/materials with source='generated' — good idempotency. User-added materials are preserved. Verified via re-planning workflow.
set_step_status also accepts 'not_started' which could regress progress. Not exposed in UI (only complete/skip surfaced), so low risk, but consider restricting server-side to forward transitions.
outcome endpoint accepts any string for actual_cost/actual_duration — fine for MVP but consider light validation (numeric parse for cost) later.
seed_data_creation: Transient TEST_b03_* users created via /api/auth/register for pytest (each isolates in its own property). On the demo_home account the UI drive created a project 'Install a Floating Oak Shelf' (marked completed after save) and a rich test room 'TEST_B03_Kitchen' with an asset 'TEST_Range' — main agent can leave or delete as desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: B03 backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_home_intel_projects_b03.py (15 cases, ~20s runtime; requires backend up and Emergent LLM key). B01+B02 regression suite is /app/backend/tests/test_home_intel_blueprints.py (21 cases, ~9s). Both should stay 100% green. Frontend end-to-end drive is deterministic: login via /auth (auth-email-input / auth-password-input / auth-submit-button) → /home-intel → hi-projects → proj-new → fill proj-goal + chips → proj-generate → wait ~10-30s for router.replace to /home-intel/projects/{id} → assert proj-step-complete/skip/ask/save-later/shopping/complete testIDs. Ask Homie modal uses proj-ask → proj-ask-input → proj-ask-send. Materials grouped page uses testID pattern mat-{materialId}-{have_it|need_it|unsure}. Completion save reveals next-maintenance/another/pro/done. Emergency check: POST /api/hi/projects/{id}/plan MUST return 409 for goals containing gas/fire/sparks/etc.
rca_of_issue: No new issues. Iter_46's POST /api/hi/rooms route-collision is fully resolved (legacy routes stripped from home_intelligence_engine.py; ~lines 184-186 now bear a comment noting the removal). Re-ran the exact assertions from iter_46 (rich fields + status + persistent_room_id) and all pass.
